summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a U.S. current report) furnishing an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment for its Boumadine polymetallic project in Morocco. The 2026 PEA reports an after-tax NPV(5%) of US$3.5B and 93% IRR, versus US$1,475M and 47% in the prior PEA, with a 14-year mine life (up from 11), US$463M initial capex and 0.7-year payback. This is a project-study disclosure, not a corporate special situation.
